The sanitize module handles null bytes (strip), path traversal (reject with 400-reason), Unicode/emoji (NFC normalize), and correctly leaves SQL injection to the data-access layer.

Multiple prior sessions had already completed this work. Checked .squad/memory/inbox/ files to understand what was done, verified tests pass, and confirmed the branch is clean. No duplicate work was needed.

All 15 tests in src/__tests__/query-sanitize.test.ts pass: null byte stripping (3 tests), path traversal rejection (3 tests), Unicode/emoji handling (3 tests), SQL passthrough (1 test), edge cases for undefined/null/non-string/empty/normal (5 tests).
